definition: the autistic half of how I am built, what it costs and what it gives

settled:
It is a difference in how the brain is built, and it has been around as long as there have been people. It is how I am built rather than something wrong with me.

Superpowers and kryptonite together. Much of my life has gone on finding ways to use the one to get around the other.

I would not take a pill against it. It would change me so fundamentally that I would not be me any more. What comes with it I would be rid of in a heartbeat.

The heart of it is two roots rather than one: a nervous system that runs sensitive, and not habituating.

Almost all of the kryptonite radiates out from those two, and much of the superpower side does too.

That is the parallel to ADHD, where a single trait sits at the centre instead.
